item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Water outage at UK's Gatwick airport leaves toilets out of order and restaurants closed
item.description: A power outage at a water treatment plant in south east England left toilets out of order and forced the closure of restaurants at Gatwick Airport on Sunday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pedestrian killed in hit-and-run crash on Bruce B. Downs Boulevard: HCSO
item.description: A pedestrian was killed in a hit-and-run crash early Sunday morning on Bruce B. Downs Boulevard, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office (HCSO).
